europe_now.title: Ceuta Migration Surge Prompts EU Action
europe_now.summary: Thousands of migrants have crossed into Spain's Ceuta enclave from Morocco, leading the EU to launch containment measures.

europe_now.title: Wildfires Threaten Southern Europe Amid Heatwave
europe_now.summary: Wildfires have forced evacuations in Greece and put France's Bordeaux wine region at risk, while firefighters continue to battle blazes.

top_stories.title: Ceuta Migration Crisis
top_stories.summary: Thousands of migrants have crossed from Morocco into Spain's Ceuta enclave, prompting an EU response to contain the situation. Authorities report that tens of thousands have since returned to Morocco as Spain manages the influx.

top_stories.title: European Wildfire Crisis
top_stories.summary: Wildfires have forced evacuations in Greece and threatened the Bordeaux wine region in France. Firefighters continue to battle the blazes while authorities assess damage and safety risks.
